newsitem.title: USA: TECNOL gets FDA clearance for respirator.
newsitem.headline: TECNOL gets FDA clearance for respirator.

text.p: TECNOL Medical Products Inc said Tuesday it had received permission from the Food and Drug Administration to market its PFR95 Particulate Filter Respirator and Surgical Mask as a medical device.
Before the approval, the device had been marketed as an N95 respirator approved by the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health, it said.
With the latest clearance, TECNOL can now sell the PFR95 as a device that meets Centers for Disease Control guidelines for tuberculosis exposure control.
The device accounted for $5.3 million in net sales in fiscal 1996, the company said.
